verdict.rationale: Vanta's own AI Agent is documented to draft policies, and policies are managed objects in the platform that can be listed via the API. That is thin, first-party evidence of policy authoring, but most of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: a lawyer-grade policy template library, a policy editor, version history, approval workflow, per-employee policy acceptance tracking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, policies come from a lawyer-grade template library with an editor, versioning, approvals, and per-employee acceptance tracking

citations.quote: working tirelessly across the Vanta platform to draft policies, complete questionnaires, and flag issues before they escalate
use it to list documents, policies, and evidence in your Vanta tenant
